description: This file defines the React component 'TopRecommendations' which fetches, filters, and displays the top 3 high-priority recommendations. It includes helper components for visual indicators like severity badges and savings pills, and manages fetch state with hooks and effects. The component interacts with external services for data retrieval and formatting.

methods.name: SeverityBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge indicating the severity level with color coding.

methods.name: SavingsPill
methods.description: Displays estimated savings formatted as currency inside a styled pill.

methods.name: TopRecommendations
methods.description: Main React functional component that fetches and displays top high-priority recommendations with robust loading and error handling.
